title: Kernel-check regular-orbit endpoint faithfulness
head: 872d53ca8e00435d764fb9b2fea1090b3eed49d2
body:
The binary-stream interface needs a precise implication from equality of complete dirty-input operators to equality of formal coefficients. This package kernel-checks that regular-orbit implication in Lean, including every input/output role block, and instantiates it for invertible binary 3-by-3 matrices acting on exactly three point columns. Applying a matrix to the three basis columns separates all matrix labels; that fact is proved rather than assumed in the concrete instance.

The written regular-orbit argument remains credited to woklerx's `bit-faithful-finite-address` and PR2599. The new contribution is the formal proof and its explicit application boundary, not a new width threshold or another GL3 census. Complete duplicate-free role and label lists remain named premises. Word translation, parser correspondence, the prior search certificate and physical supplier obligations remain external.

Fresh native Lean4.34.1 compilation checks16 theorem roots and rejects4 contradictory control statements. Actual axiom reports contain only `propext`, `Quot.sound` and `Classical.choice`. The runner compiles the exact hashed source bytes in a fresh directory and reuses no package oleans. Positive countermodels isolate separation, label uniqueness, label completeness and arbitrary-dirty-input requirements.

The external binding checks the exact PR2599 source at `cfafdd633cf4e2e534704ec3ddd684cb0c32734f`: all168 matrices across all512 three-column addresses, both inverse identities, and1,512 mixed coefficients across all nine blocks of three dirty roles. Native CPython3.12.7 registered checks and four export/corruption groups pass; optimized3.14.5 conformance passes. Separate OpenAI Codex review inspected the proofs/boundary, freshly compiled the Lean modules and checked the source bytes, finding no material issue. No human review or hosted CI result is claimed.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/regular-orbit-lean-interface
python -I -O -B research/regular-orbit-lean-interface/formal_verify.py --lean /path/to/lean
```

The first command does **not** compile Lean; its retained receipt check establishes integrity only. The second requires Lean4.34.1 commit `5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52` and performs a fresh kernel check. README and BOUNDARY map the proved propositions and external assumptions explicitly. No all-width formalization, PR1974 census formalization, compiler, supplier or exponent improvement is claimed.

Started from freshly fetched canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority4; the prescribed baseline and formal-interface first reading passed. Submission refresh confirmed unchanged main/source. Cached679-PR and1,197-Discussion records were supplemented by recent60 PRs and source comments; Discussion coverage after12:29UTC is limited, not a novelty guarantee. Selection, scope refinement, provenance and open next questions are in TASK.json. Advance claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2599#issuecomment-6196285563.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Next obligations are a kernel-certified GL3 enumeration/encoding and a proved source-pinned word evaluator.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
